coaches.name: Carolyn Dorin-Ballard
coaches.bio: At 25, Carolyn joined the LPBT tour (later PWBA) and won 20 national championships, including three majors in her career. She also captured two USBC/PBA Women's World Series titles as well as the World Tour Championship in 2011. This 2008 USBC Hall of Famer admits she was never the most talented, but credits hard work and determination for her success.

coaches.name: Del Ballard, Jr.
coaches.bio: At 18 years of age, Del joined the PBA and earned 13 titles which included four major championships of which two were U.S. Open titles. He is ranked 29th among the greatest of all time and is currently one of the top national and international bowling coaches in the world. This 2009 USBC Hall of Famer is currently the Storm/Roto Grip PBA Tour rep as well as an international coach for Team Hong Kong.
